nodes.label: Graphify Enforcement PreToolUse Hook
nodes.rationale: PreToolUse hooks intercept Bash grep/find/rg/ripgrep commands and Read/Glob calls on source-like file extensions, injecting a reminder that graphify-out/graph.json exists and must be queried (graphify query/explain/path) before raw grepping or reading, to keep exploration scoped and cheap rather than brute-forcing the codebase.

nodes.label: Buffer-Then-Chunk SSE Streaming
nodes.rationale: Chosen over live token-by-token ChatClient.stream() so the output guardrail can run before the client sees any text; cost is that it is not 'real' streaming.
nodes.community_name: Project Docs, CI Workflows & Daily Logs

nodes.label: boundedElastic Bedrock/Qdrant Bridging
nodes.rationale: Bedrock and Qdrant have no reactive-native client in this Spring AI version, so wrapping their blocking calls on Schedulers.boundedElastic() is correct practice, not a gap; only Postgres had a real reactive alternative (R2DBC).
nodes.community_name: Project Docs, CI Workflows & Daily Logs

nodes.label: JPA-to-R2DBC Migration
nodes.rationale: Only user/* and ChatService.validateParticipantIds were migrated because Postgres is the one store with a reactive driver; a blocking JDBC DataSource is kept solely for Flyway migrations.
nodes.community_name: Project Docs, CI Workflows & Daily Logs

nodes.label: Thin-Alias Root Makefile
nodes.rationale: Every recipe shells out to gradlew/npm/docker/node so Gradle stays the source of truth; goal was discoverability of commands split across module scopes and differing docker build contexts, not new build capability. Written for macOS GNU make 3.81.
nodes.community_name: Project Docs, CI Workflows & Daily Logs

nodes.label: Data-tier ingress by CIDR not SG (avoids module dependency cycle)
nodes.rationale: rds-postgres, qdrant-ec2 and msk allow the app subnet CIDRs (var.app_subnet_cidrs) rather than referencing the ECS task security group, to avoid a module dependency cycle with the container-env wiring. To be tightened to SG references once the env root owns a shared app SG.
nodes.norm_label: data-tier ingress by cidr not sg (avoids module dependency cycle)

nodes.label: envs/staging and envs/prod deliberately duplicated
nodes.rationale: The two env roots are duplicated rather than sharing a root module, same reasoning as the duplicated application-{staging,prod}.properties: a shared root would couple the environments and Terraform's composition story for per-env divergence (AZ count, RDS multi-AZ, task counts/sizes) is cleaner as explicit copies.
